summary: Ridgetech Inc. filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) to disclose entry into a sales agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering program with Pacific Century Securities LLC as agent. The agreement replaces a prior sales agent and authorizes sale of up to $184,720,213 in ordinary shares. Terms include a 3.5% commission plus up to $100,000 in expense reimbursement. The filing is a routine capital-raising arrangement—not a special situation—and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven category.
